title: Planket
description: A Fabric mod that modifies Minecraft creative mode inventory style.
body:
Powered by Gemini and DeepSeek.

由 Gemini 和 DeepSeek 提供技术支持。

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/hhbbGUwx/images/557c4d3d134a52ce64f534978f672fd06951c45d_350.webp)

## Features 特色

* Keeps the player's inventory permanently visible on the right side of the creative inventory screen, making it easier to drag items from tabs into your inventory without switching back and forth.
* 在创造模式物品栏右侧常驻显示玩家背包，无需来回切换标签页，方便拿取。

## Notes 注意事项

* This mod is still in early beta. It may cause visual glitches or even crash your client in rare cases. **Please back up your saves before use** .
* 此模组仍处于早期测试阶段，可能导致画面卡顿或闪烁，甚至损坏存档（小概率），**请务必及时备份存档** 。
